Definition: 1 if no quotation is recorded in the 180 days before the assessment date. This is a provisional inactivity proxy, not a verified churn outcome.
Rule-based descriptive grouping using quotation recency, quoted value, and inactivity. Segment priority: Inactive Quote, High Quote Value, Recent Activity, then Standard / Review.
Forward-looking customer value estimate. Actual collected revenue, delivery costs, and retention history are required for a validated estimate. Quoted value is not actual collected revenue.
